audit: County-held-out association of provided rural language-vulnerability context with frozen S1 disagreement residual; diagnostic only

method.outcome: Frozen orthogonalized S1 Queen/Rook disagreement residual consumed unchanged; not a target label.
method.feature: One preregistered product: provided svi_minority × (1 - provided pct_urban). No D1 RUCA blend, external demographics, or additional interaction terms.
method.cross_validation: Leave one supported five-digit county GEOID out at a time within each official region; train/held-out counties are disjoint.
method.baseline: Training-region mean residual; augmented model is training-region intercept plus the single linear product term.
method.scaling: The interaction is standardized within each official region using training counties only (training tract mean and population SD); held-out county values use those frozen fold moments.
method.metric: Pooled county-held-out ΔR²=(baseline OOF SSE-augmented OOF SSE)/shared S1 residual SST.
method.confidence_interval: Paired county-block bootstrap resampling held-out county OOF blocks with replacement within each official region.
method.strata: Rural/urban uses provided pct_urban <0.5 / >=0.5. SVI quartiles are computed within official region from provided svi_minority, without outcome use; report raw frozen-residual summaries and paired held-out ΔR² by pooled stratum.
method.interpretation_limit: Label-free provided-feature association only; not target accuracy, causal evidence, or estimator-promotion evidence.

county_block_bootstrap.resampling: paired leave-one-county-out predictions; counties resampled with replacement within each official region

config.county_holdout: leave one five-digit GEOID county out within each official region
config.augmented: training-region intercept and one linear term
config.scaling: term mean and population SD computed on training tracts from other counties within the same region only
config.svi_quartiles: within-region empirical quartiles of provided svi_minority; thresholds descriptive and target-independent

interpretation: The single-term county-held-out screen failed one or more predeclared thresholds; retain descriptive results only and do not integrate.
